name: class II major histocompatibility complex transactivator
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CIITA encodes MHC class II transactivator. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription corepressor activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to MHC class II deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
